recent_changes.description: Implemented Real-time Subscription capability on both `/hybrid` and `/hybrid-v2` routes to push new intents from Supabase channel.
Moved Intent Detail Page to root (/intent/[id]) to support universal linking. Integrated actual API endpoints for POST comments and updating match_count logic.

errors_encountered.error: Intent Detail linking loop in IntentCard (basePath issue)
errors_encountered.solution: Refactored IntentCard to accept basePath as an empty string '""' for root rendering instead of '/demo', escaping the demo sub-layout.

decisions_made.decision: Fetch Real Data Fallback over fully deprecating Mock Data
decisions_made.reason: Keeps the demo UI lighting fast initially while transparently supporting new user posts from the live database.

decisions_made.decision: Detail Page uses Root Layout vs Demo Layout
decisions_made.reason: Because elements in `/demo` require SavedContext Provider and other visual heavy Demo sidebar overlays, whereas the actual feature should be generic and link-friendly from `/hybrid` modes.
